title: Remove a Visible Gemini Watermark from an Image
description: Clean up visible Gemini labels or marks from images you are authorized to edit. Does not remove invisible SynthID signals.
heading: Remove visible Gemini marks from your images
intro: Use a focused image cleanup workflow for visible labels and overlays. Invisible provenance signals such as SynthID are outside this tool’s scope.

faq.question: Does this remove Google SynthID?
faq.answer: No. This page concerns visible marks only and does not detect or remove invisible SynthID signals.

faq.question: What image formats are supported?
faq.answer: You can upload JPG, PNG, and WEBP images up to 10 MB.

faq.question: Are my images kept private?
faq.answer: Files are stored in private object storage and scheduled for automatic deletion after 24 hours.

faq.question: Can I remove any watermark?
faq.answer: Only edit images you own or have permission to modify. Some protected or complex marks may require manual editing.
